title: LinkedIn Learning Course Input
description: Pull LinkedIn Learning course data without a cookie or login. Provide course URLs, instructor names, or keywords.

courseUrls.title: Course URLs
courseUrls.description: Direct LinkedIn Learning course URLs. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/learning/learning-python'.

instructorNames.title: Instructor names
instructorNames.description: Instructor names whose LinkedIn Learning courses you want to scrape. The actor uses public search engine discovery and verifies the instructor on each course page. Examples: 'Madecraft', 'Olivia Chiu Stone'.

keywords.title: Keyword search
keywords.description: Topics to discover courses for via public search engines. Examples: 'python data analysis', 'project management', 'prompt engineering'.

maxCourses.title: Max courses per source
maxCourses.description: Hard cap on courses per instructor or keyword. Set to 0 to take everything we can discover. Ignored for direct courseUrls.

includeCurriculum.title: Include curriculum
includeCurriculum.description: Pull the chapter and lesson breakdown. Turn off to keep only summary fields and reduce row size.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Higher concurrency runs faster but increases proxy and detection risk. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
